name: Fire extinguishers, hydrant hoses, SCBA sets on manned platforms
description: Portable and semi-portable extinguishers, fire-main hydrants and hoses, and self-contained breathing apparatus for fire teams on manned offshore installations. Evidence is from USCG Outer Continental Shelf and Deepwater Port regulations, SOLAS/IMO sources, US 46 CFR emergency-equipment rules and an OEM product catalogue. Primary source: https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-46/section-77.30-5
aliases: Fire extinguishers, hydrant hoses, SCBA sets on manned platforms

specifications.metric: Self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA — Minimum air supply
specifications.basis: 46 CFR 77.30-5(a): each SCBA must be pressure-demand open-circuit type, MSHA and NIOSH approved, with at minimum a 30-minute air supply and a full facepiece
33 CFR 145.01(b)(2): monthly inspections required by NFPA 10 may be conducted by owner, operator, person-in-charge or designated crew member

specifications.metric: Reliability — Annual extinguisher maintenance and hydrostatic test
specifications.basis: 33 CFR 145.01(b)(1) and (4): annual maintenance/recharging to NFPA 10; hydrostatic pressure tests by qualified servicing facility
